text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —My, what a wondrous place... Could we be... high up above the sky?

text_block_list.name: Little Bird
text_block_list.text: Beep beep beep...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what beautiful blue feathers...!
You must be Aozora-san.

text_block_list.name: Little Bird
text_block_list.text: Pee-ruri... Pipit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Is something the matter?
Look this way. ...Do you have business with me?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Pitter-patter...)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
I could never refuse an invitation from the breeze of your wings.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Please wait.
I'm coming right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A soft light envelops Yamanin Zephyr as she chases after the little bird. And then—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... Someone from the Academy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whoosh...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Light dances upon the flower-scented breeze.
The season when a hundred flowers bloom.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...What wonderfully warm sunshine.
Ah, if only I could stay here forever."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: This is—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a beautiful sea...!
Stretching out lush and blue, undulating, with the sea breeze rushing past—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...The breath of summer is...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...The trees, the birds, the insects.
It feels as though everything is breathing
in unison with the sea.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...This is the place!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
A sea of crimson...
It looks as though the entire forest is ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The sky is high, dappled with mackerel clouds.
In the autumn breeze, a faint scent of winter—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"...It falls, deepens, and shines.
No matter how many times I see it, it's a truly captivating view."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —...A world of silver...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Even my breath is white.
The occasional gust of snow only brings a fleeting shimmer with it...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Besides... ah, what silence.
It's as if the entire world is fast asleep.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: —Oh dear, did I doze off...? Then, that must have been a dream.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...No, even so.
I truly saw the heart in this place.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"What a magnificent view.
Thank you so much, Aozora."
